description: FICTIONAL Federation port network (docs/variant_surveillance_spec.md §3), for the Enterprise platforms. Every value here is invented for the fictional setting: none of it is literature-anchored and none of it may be reported as a measured surveillance capability. The port identifiers are not real UN/LOCODEs either, only five-letter codes shaped like them so the existing loader and schema apply unchanged. The gradient is calibrated against the real regions rather than against the ship: Starbase 1 sits near Miami, Starbase 74 near Copenhagen, Risa near Cozumel, K-7 near Juneau, and Memory Alpha is the one genuinely uninstrumented call. Populations enter the hazard prior and the shore model's population field only. Syndromic and WBE labels use the fiction-adapted pathogen names of data/pathogens/enterprise_tos_profiles.json and enterprise_tng_profiles.json so picard_framework/analysis/shore/detection.py resolves them instead of raising, alongside the same lowercase generic labels the four real regions use ('norovirus' everywhere, 'SARS-CoV-2' only where the programme is dense) so the shipped active profiles resolve here too.

SBONE.note: Fictional. Homeport of both itineraries; the best-instrumented call, roughly Miami's programme at a starbase's catchment.

SBELV.note: Fictional. Standard programme, Rigelian Fever endemic; roughly Barcelona.

FARPT.note: Fictional. Limited frontier programme, Barclay Protomorphosis endemic, no municipal WBE; roughly Roatan.

DSNIN.note: Fictional. The chokepoint: heavy arrival screening and municipal WBE on a mixed-jurisdiction programme with a slow syndromic pathway; roughly Singapore.

SBSVF.note: Fictional. No endemic pathogen of its own; short delays and dense WBE make it the ceiling a shipboard sentinel is measured against, as Copenhagen is in the nordic library.

RISAA.note: Fictional. The Federation's Cozumel: the largest catchment in the region, high mixing, minimal programme, no WBE. The spec's 50 000 population enters the hazard prior and the shore model only.

MEMAL.note: Fictional. The one call with no public health programme at all (spec surveillance level 'None'), so syndromic_enabled is false rather than a coverage of zero: the port reports nothing and the shore model returns no detection epoch for it, which is stated here rather than emerging from an unresolvable label.

KSEVN.note: Fictional. Limited border-station programme with reference-lab confirmation but a long turnaround and no WBE; roughly Juneau.
